references.name: whole-roof-reference
references.author: European Space Agency
references.observed: Ordinary whole-city aerial reference inspected. White station roof is an oval whose long direction follows the NE/SW railway axis; multiple parallel curved roof ridges/bands cover a broad station between converging tracks. Surrounding city blocks and transport loops remain separate. Resolution establishes gross roof silhouette only; it does not establish individual hidden facade bays or rail clearances. No imagery used as a texture.

references.name: south-front
references.author: N509FZ
references.observed: Ordinary southern exterior photograph inspected. Broad curved dark grey rolled metal roof edge and deep soffit, continuous two-level blue-grey glazing with dark mullions, a curved raised white approach/arrival deck on substantial pale columns, ground entry glazing, and a curved metal/steel canopy volume at the right. No copied lettering, emblems, lamps/people/bikes/sign inventory. Hidden elevations, dimensions and exact levels remain interpretations.
